question: If acceptance is refuted, whose instrument serves going?
premises: Yet whatever acceptance-share there is in going has the hand-organ as fit instrument, not the foot-named.
inference: Acceptance-as-grasping refuted, but the acceptance-share in going belongs to the hand, not the foot.
plain_english: And this acceptance stands refuted — yet whatever share of acceptance there is in going, for that the hand-organ is the fit instrument, not the foot-named.
